experiment: STARTS S1SH: frozen S1-only Nov3 vs QAOA at N15 L=1 and L=2, Q=qL

hypothesis.one_sentence: Under frozen TQA-only S1 at N15, cold L=1 and L=2 with Q=qL show whether the Nov3−QAOA energy gap exists before L=3/6 fade.
hypothesis.not: Not continuation/warm-start. Not extra budget. Not S4/S8. Not a GR patch. Distinct from DEPTH C1 (4-start continuation on 10036-43) and local R10 (2-start 10026-31).

frozen_from_PR83_84_85.split: same C0 split_cap(Q, nstarts=1); Q=1024*L inclusive
frozen_from_PR83_84_85.optimizer: ordinary IID Rademacher SPSA C0, ncal=4, A=25, live per-start gain, last+Polyak, energy min

allocation.S1: One start = TQA at that L. Full Q=1024*L, K from split_cap(Q, 1).
allocation.QAOA: p=L, same S1 split, same Q.
allocation.inclusive: All init, calibration, perturbations, candidates, failures inside Q.
allocation.cold: Each L fitted independently from TQA. No L1 continuation.

selection: Lowest counted candidate energy. F post hoc, never selects.

questions.primary: For each L, paired mean Δ(E−E0)/N of Nov3−QAOA with bootstrap 95% CI, wins, tails. F reported, not selected.
questions.soft_note: If at some L the Nov3−QAOA energy CI lies entirely below 0, mark that L as a development energy-win candidate. Not a GR adoption. Otherwise report whether the gap is already present at shallow depth.

gr: Do not patch GR even if some L is an energy-win candidate. S1 remains a candidate.
